fit_reason: Whole pickup truck listed by a private seller.
findings: Paint on hood and doors is fairly glossy but shows mild dullness and water-spot haze on the driver side door and hood in the side shots
Light road film and dirt along the lower tan rocker panels and fender flares
Chrome grille and front bumper show some water spotting and haze
Black plastic lower front valance looks slightly faded and gray
Light brake dust and grime on the wheels
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the F350. It already looks well kept, but a pre-sale wash and wax would clean up the haze on the chrome grille and bumper and bring the faded black lower front trim back to a deep black. We do mobile details and come to you. Would you like a quote?
